root_cause: RSS producer forwarded raw RFC 2822 pubDate (e.g. 'Wed, 11 Nov 2026 04:37:00 GMT') as published_at; verified reader _utc() accepted ISO-8601 only, failing run ingest-de7de36ab114 item news-cna-202611110105-aspx.

fix.reader: collector_bundle._strict_rfc2822_utc (published_at only): full RFC 2822 date, GMT/UT/UTC or 4-digit numeric offset (hh<=23, mm<=59), weekday/calendar validated, no trailing text; no-zone/-0000/named zones/+080/+1260 rejected; ISO path unchanged; raw bytes/hashes verified first.
fix.producer: pollers._rss_pub_iso uses the same strict parser; invalid literals pass through unchanged so the reader rejects them; raw item bytes keep the original literal.

recorded_rss_bundle: test_recorded_rss_bundle_* build a sanitized RSS item bundle for news-cna-202611110105-aspx through CollectorBundleAdapter.pull(): exact 'Wed, 11 Nov 2026 04:37:00 GMT' (old code: fails ISO-8601) == equivalent ISO instant 2026-11-11T04:37:00Z; raw sha256 hash and replay stable.
